text:
taylor: quick follow-up from the nightly postmortem: backup-cleanup job produced a flood of pages ~09:40-09:50 UTC. ~90 pages, ~78% duplicates. We need a short mitigation plan with owners and firm due dates.

priya: root causes I saw: retry spikes, alert threshold tuned too low for sharded job, and no upstream collapse. Recommend three small changes.

nate: Proposed owners/dates: 
1) bump backup-cleanup alert threshold 5 -> 20 failures/10m. owner: nate. due: 2025-02-20. ticket: SINF-621.
2) ingestion collapse: dedupe identical fingerprints for 120s, include count in alert body. owner: priya. due: 2025-02-18.
3) paging policy: add 'scheduled-job' label and silence by default for known cron windows; implement group_interval 4m. owner: lucas. due: 2025-02-17.

lucas: I'll add a short ops-config PR to tag scheduled jobs and add silence rules; will include a small test harness.

priya: For dedupe, plan to collapse but preserve host list and total_count. small ingestion change + unit test.

taylor: sample grouping to add to Alertmanager: ```group_by: ['alertname','scheduled_job']
group_interval: 4m
repeat_interval: 2h```

ops-bot: Created SINF-621 - "backup-cleanup alert noise" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-621

nate: I'll open the threshold PR and reference the ticket.

priya: I'll push the dedupe change and gate it with a feature flag for 48h rollouts.

tl;dr taylor: collapse+count, bump threshold, auto-silence scheduled jobs. 15m sync Thu 09:00 UTC to verify PRs. If any owner needs to swap, speak now.
